profile.summary: A nonprofit focused on early literacy through family engagement and building a love of reading. Its Always Reading program supports at-home reading for transitional kindergarten and kindergarten students by giving families digital tablets, access to digital books, and support from Book Coaches. It serves communities in California and Hawaii.
